name: fix-softlock
description: A web game that softlocks after the third coin (the player freezes while the game still says playing): playtest-loop must find it with the bots, file it as a regression, fix it, and prove the fix. Judged by an explorer that must find no softlock, the goal bot reaching the exit with every coin, and a regression on file.

input.goal: collect all five coins and reach the exit

checks.name: no softlock and the goal reached
